MP2 regression fixtures: synthesized 997 Hz sine waves, no third-party media.

Generated with FFmpeg's `sine` source and `mp2` encoder:
- mp2-stereo-48k.mp2: 48000 Hz, stereo, 192 kbps, 0.12 seconds (MPEG-1).
- mp2-mono-24k.mp2: 24000 Hz, mono, 64 kbps, 0.15 seconds (MPEG-2).

These generated test signals are dedicated to the public domain (CC0).
